thread:
emily: Quick sync idea 1 - 'remediation passport' + SLA ladder to stop followups dying in the backlog. sketching short flow below. PTAL.

rashid: sounds useful. paste the flow pls.

emily: here's the compact flow, keeping it minimal so teams actually do it:

```
Remediation passport (create at T+12h):
- fields: owner, backup, severity, rollback-owner, fingerprint-tags, short scope, initial ETA
- auto-created by ops-bot from incident metadata; editable by owner

SLA ladder (enforced):
- Assign owner <= 12h (auto-assign to IC if none)
- Scope doc <= 72h
- Active checkpoint <= 7d (status + blockers)
- QA/regress check <= 21d
- Closure review <= 45d

Escalation rule: if same fingerprint seen 3x within 120d -> auto-open "pattern RCA" and page SRE lead + product lead
```

marta: love the passport idea. makes it easy to transfer ownership. can ops-bot scaffold it?

ops-bot: yes. command: `/ops passport create --incident $ID --owner @emily --backup @marta --severity B --due 7d` will generate the passport and followups. It will DM owner at T+12h, T+72h, T+7d, and 14d if overdue.

kevin: can we add a small status badge in Console next to incidents: passport:complete/incomplete, overdue:yes/no. PMs asked for exportable timelines for customers.

emily: add export CSV + JSON for execs/PMs. CSV header idea: `incident_id,passport_id,owner,backup,severity,created_at,due_at,status,fingerprint`.

rashid: on IC rotation: propose 5-day IC blocks but keep the "followup shepherd" (backup) distinct for 14d after incident. reduces mid-remediation flip flop and spreads load.

marta: agree, and include a short "handoff script" the outgoing IC runs: confirm passport present, confirm backup assigned, post short note in incident thread.

al: metrics/targets for pilot? I suggest: assign-within-12h >= 90%, median time-to-scope <= 72h, overdue@21d < 8%, repeat-fingerprint drop >= 25% over 12 weeks.

emily: good targets. I'll run an 8-week pilot with next oncall rotation. will post weekly digest: counts by severity, avg times, and a small list of repeat fingerprints.

kevin: I'll add a Console tile: open passports, overdue %, and a small filter by fingerprint. CSV export endpoint too.

ops-bot: Pilot kickoff scheduled: Mon 2025-02-03 09:00 PST. Will scaffold passports for new incidents during pilot and post weekly summaries to #eng-oncall.

emily: thanks all. I'll update the runbook with the passport template, SLA ladder, and handoff script and drop a one-pager in the channel tomorrow. :rocket:
